skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to design a project management process based on results-oriented management principles, including planning, monitoring, and evaluation.

Students will be able to establish a monitoring and evaluation system for project implementation, set up tools and forms to collect information and report on project outcomes, and practice writing evaluation reports.
Students will be able to analyze the relationships between different levels of outcomes in development issues and identify the nature of each development activity.
Students will be able to evaluate development indicators according to SMART criteria and select appropriate evaluation methods based on context and requirements.
Students will be able to organize and manage group discussions to analyze stakeholders and defend ideas for developing monitoring and evaluation systems.
Students will be able to apply economic and social knowledge to build outcome frameworks and use monitoring and evaluation system tools.
Students will be able to work independently, utilize English language resources, and demonstrate a passion for community service.
Students will be able to present project content and defend project ideas in group settings.
Students will be able to design a sample evaluation report suitable for the evaluation format and requirements.
Students will be able to cultivate a self-learning attitude, independently explore international resources, and take responsibility for their own and group products.
